scope: Complete retail 418140 ETEX 80000 setup and 41a750 motion: active mask/index, position, scalar speed/angle, velocity, timer, polar slot fields, duration. Preserves native reset-to-zero timer and expiry mask FFFFFFF6. After setup, controlled active bits 1/8 exercise that mask. Durations -1/0 compare local motion only: they retain 80000 and cause native full-update retry to loop, so no full-update equivalence claim for those durations. Rates 0/.5/1/1.25 and explicit extreme angles compared. Animation, collision and pixels excluded
